variant.description: The visual style of the table.

layout.description: `grow` stretches columns to fill the available width, `fixed` keeps columns at their configured sizes. Column virtualization always behaves as `fixed`.

striped.description: Whether to add zebra-stripes to the rows.

stickyHeader.description: Keeps the header visible while the body scrolls.

children.description: Custom row renderer. The body keeps owning the loop, empty state and virtualization, the callback only decides what each row looks like. Spread `rowProps` into `table.Row`.

onRowClick.description: Rows become clickable and keyboard-interactive when set. Applies to the default row rendering, custom `children` handle their own interaction.

renderExpandedRow.description: Renders an extra full-width row below rows where `getIsExpanded()` is true. Not supported in combination with row virtualization.

emptyState.description: Rendered when the row model is empty.

columns.description: Whether to virtualize the center (unpinned) columns (horizontal). Pinned columns always render.

rowOptions.description: Options passed to the row virtualizer, for example `overscan` or `estimateSize`.

columnOptions.description: Options passed to the column virtualizer.

sticky.description: Keeps the footer visible while the body scrolls.
